facts.fact: The education ministry's statistics directorate (DGESS, MENAPLN) reports in February 2024 on the pilot phase of a national file of pupils with unique identification, online pupil registration and school identity cards, and lists prospects for generalisation as still ahead; the passages give no count of schools.
facts.system: Fichier d'Identification Unique des Élèves du Burkina Faso (FIUE-BF)

facts.fact: The pilot-phase report on the FIUE-BF is issued by the education ministry (MENAPLN), through its Direction générale des études et des statistiques sectorielles, as the ministry's own initiative; date is the document's, February 2024.
facts.system: Fichier d'Identification Unique des Élèves du Burkina Faso (FIUE-BF)

facts.fact: The report's account of the pilot phase lists activities carried out on the general budget, alongside an implementation agreement between MENAPLN and Luxembourg and support from the WURI project; no amounts appear in the passages, and the date is the document's, February 2024.
facts.system: Fichier d'Identification Unique des Élèves du Burkina Faso (FIUE-BF)

note: The passages file holds only the cover and table of contents of an 8,047-word report: headings name data collection, data entry, pupil enrolment, card production and entry of end-of-year decisions, but who enters what, at which level and in how many schools is not in the passages.
